description: Risk model input. Computed for one address from USDC Transfer logs at or before a given block. Every implementation (model/src/model/features.py, indexer/src/features.ts) must match spec/vectors.json exactly.

transfer_fields.log_index: integer log index within the block

ordering: Transfers are processed in (block, log_index) order. Self-transfers (from == to) and transfers involving the zero address are ignored everywhere, including first-seen times.

features.name: log_transfer_count
features.definition: ln(1 + n), n = number of transfers where the address is from or to

features.name: out_in_ratio
features.definition: total outflow value / total inflow value, clipped to [0, 2]; 0 if inflow is 0

features.name: fan_in
features.definition: distinct senders / number of inflow transfers; 0 if there are no inflows

features.name: repeat_share
features.definition: share of the address's transfers whose counterparty already appeared in an earlier transfer of this address; 0 if n is 0

features.name: fresh_sender_share
features.definition: share of inflow value sent by senders whose first transfer anywhere (as sender or receiver) happened at most fresh_window_s seconds before this inflow; 0 if inflow is 0

features.name: log_median_hold
features.definition: ln(1 + median over outflows of min(hold_cap_s, ts(outflow) - ts(latest inflow at or before it))) / ln(1 + hold_cap_s). Outflows with no earlier inflow count as hold_cap_s. 1 if there are no outflows. Median of an even count is the mean of the two middle values.

quantization.scheme: felt = round_half_even(x * 2^input_scale). All features are non-negative.
